provenance.disclosure: Aggregate public-safe summary only; no private or pair-level source content is reproduced.

reference_ceiling.note: Reference/evaluation ceiling for the frozen pilot, not a production success rate.

baseline_comparison.claim_boundary: This comparison describes the frozen test harness, not real-world hiring or application outcomes.

jd_parser_rescore.note: Aggregate parser score after ground-truth corrections and scoring changes; it is not an ATS score.

safeguard_example.reason: Improvement was not statistically significant and was below the configured materiality threshold.
safeguard_example.significance_gate: ANOVA p >= 0.05 blocked deployment in the retained safeguard snapshot.

interpretation: Evaluation data is separated into train, validation and held-out partitions.
Changes are compared against frozen cases rather than judged from anecdotal outputs.
Fabrication, metric preservation and date preservation are measured separately.
A change can be blocked even when it appears subjectively acceptable if evidence does not show a material improvement.
Human review remains a release gate.
limitations: Historical snapshots from May 2026; they are not live product metrics.
The public summary does not expose pair-level prompts, CVs, job descriptions or personal data.
Scores belong to the original harness definitions and should not be compared directly with unrelated benchmarks.
